name: jamesgibson
description: The James Gibson seed — an expert Node.js Platform Architect living in Denver, CO — his story, his basics, his specialties and his employment history, as a seed carries them.

pitches.reader: The story of a Node.js platform architect: basics, specialties, employment, and where the career lives.
pitches.grower: Every fact in the seed is tied back to the author — via, and to where it came from.
pitches.maintainer: A story site with no search and no CMS; the seed is the tree, the pages are the leaves.
pitches.packager: A seed that grows — extending it means adding sections and leaves, not re-architecting the trunk.
